text: Price was my first question. The per-team number was clear, but I had to ask what happens at the end of the 12 months.
Went live in two weeks. I expected months. Our CRM admin needed one call with their team to turn on the connector.
Integration took longer than the sales call suggested. Nobody told me which HubSpot setups they test against, and my team copied handoff notes by hand for two weeks.
We compared it with Relaymark. Relaymark charges per seat and Contoso charges per team, and that changed how our finance team saw it.
A sync failed during quarter-end week and it took a day to reach a support engineer. I wanted to know the response time before signing.
Our year-end push starts in October. I asked whether we can add a second team for 3 months only. We could.
Payback was the question my board asked. We got about 5 months on our numbers.
